summary: Created appworker on node1 with persistent login-session limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified both soft and hard limits before and after reboot.
actions_performed: Created appworker with home directory and /bin/bash.
Configured soft and hard nofile limits to 8192.
Configured soft and hard nproc limits to 256.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified persistence.

evidence.requirement: appworker account and effective login-session resource limits
evidence.summary: The account exists, its persistent configuration contains the requested limits, and fresh PAM login sessions report Max open files 8192/8192 and Max processes 256/256.

Baseline boot ID a4139d3b-4eba-4628-807d-d5a84aa5c913 was captured with healthy account limits; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to e80ec018-6e85-48d9-8196-4eca84ca79d7, and the account, home, configuration, and effective limits recovered.
